Their style could be described as a combination of unusual grooves, driving and swinging rhythms and many borrowings from different music cultures.
Quintessence (English band) | Quintessence was a rock band formed in April 1969 in Notting Hill, London, England.  Their style was a mixture of jazz, psychedelic rock and progressive rock with an influence of music from India.

The band has African music influences.
